card.name: Daily and cycle words before duration
card.fires_on: The word right after a daily-timing term such as daily, day, diurnal or annual, often a linking word like for, with or at, or the word cycle. It appears in dosing-schedule text.

modes.label: Cycle after time word
modes.description: The word cycle after diurnal or annual.
modes.example: disturbance in the diurnal<< cycle>> with maintenance of elevated corticoid values

modes.label: Link word after daily
modes.description: A small word like for, with or at right after daily or day in dosing directions.

modes.label: Dose frequency abbreviation
modes.description: Part of a frequency abbreviation like Q-I-D or the word day after times a.
modes.example: times a<< day>> Duration of therapy is based on recovery from
